plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner read: brand lockup anchors the left edge, headline and subline fill a wide center column, and the bottle closes the strip on the right, mirroring the original's brand → message → product order.
Product-first strip: the bottle leads at the left edge as the visual hook, the headline block reads straight out of it, and the logo signs off on the right like a brand end-card.

Message-led strip: the headline block starts flush left with maximum width for the largest type, while logo and bottle sit together on the right as one tight brand-and-product cluster, echoing the original's text-left / bottle-right split.
